    //==
    // # IDeformation3D catalog

    // Twist about Axis: angle accumulates with signed height along the axis.
    Eval(self: Twist3D, p: Point3D): Point3D
        => RotateAboutAxis(
            self.Origin,
            self.Axis,
            self.AnglePerUnit * self.Origin.Between(p).Dot(self.Axis.Vector),
            p);

    Eval(self: Bend3D, p: Point3D): Point3D
        => RotateAboutAxis(
            self.Origin,
            self.Axis,
            (self.Curvature * self.Origin.Between(p).Dot(self.Direction.Vector)).Angle,

    // Taper: scale the perpendicular offset by (1 + Rate * t).
    Eval(self: Taper3D, p: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var o = self.Origin.Between(p);
        var t = o.Dot(self.Axis.Vector);
        var scale = 1.0 + self.Rate * t;
        return self.Origin
            + self.Axis.Vector * t
            + PerpendicularComponent(o, self.Axis.Vector) * scale;
    }
```

    // Spherify: lerp toward the radial projection onto the sphere.
    Eval(self: Spherify3D, p: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var o = self.Center.Between(p);
        var lenSq = o.Dot(o);
        var dir = lenSq > 0.0000001 ? o.Normalize : Vector3D.UnitZ;
        return p.Lerp(self.Center + dir * self.Radius, self.Strength);
    }
```

    // Planar taper: scale the perpendicular offset by (1 + Rate * t).
    Eval(self: Taper2D, p: Point2D): Point2D
    {
        var o = self.Origin.Between(p);
        var axis = self.Axis.Vector;
        var t = o.Dot(axis);
        var scale = 1.0 + self.Rate * t;
        var perp = o - axis * t;
        return self.Origin + axis * t + perp * scale;
    }
```

    // Polar swirl: rotate about Origin by AnglePerUnit times radius.
    Eval(self: Twist2D, p: Point2D): Point2D
    {
        var o = self.Origin.Between(p);
        var r = o.Magnitude;
        return self.Origin + o.Transform(Rotation2D(self.AnglePerUnit * r));
    }
```
